record.question: In an underground coal mine, the percentage of inflammable gas should not exceed ____ in the general body of the return air of any ventilating district and ____ in any place in the mine:
record.explanation: The permissible inflammable-gas limit is 0.75% in the general body of return air and 1.25% in any place.
